annotations.text:
HOME — what you land on each morning.
Answers one question: what needs me today? Everything here is an action, not a statistic — which is why there is no "total clients" vanity tile.
Clicking any name drops you into that client's detail.

CLIENTS — the drill-down from Home.
Everyone on one screen, problems sorted to the top. The three columns the spreadsheet can't give you: trend direction, compliance %, and staleness.

Week banding mirrors the merged WEEK column in your sheet, but each band now carries its own averages.
Missing days appear as inline rows rather than silent blanks.
Accent colour is a live control on each artboard (the chip above the frame) — lime, cyan, orange and violet are loaded. Nothing else in the palette changes.

CHECK-IN — the landing screen.
One scroll, five sections, one submit. Every control is at least 44px tall; the 1–10 scales are sliders with a big readout rather than ten tiny targets.
Typed inputs kill the messy sheet data: no more "79 kg" in a number column.

AFTER SUBMITTING — the same screen collapses to a done state and progress moves up.
Shows compliance, measurements and photos, as agreed. Form-check notes stay coach-only.
Edit stays available the same day.

PLAN — read-only, and the only screen a consultation client ever sees.
Macros are per meal group (D-1), matching how you already write them.
Supplements are regrouped BY TIMING rather than by supplement — say if you'd rather keep the sheet's order.
